topic: Photograph a blank form before filling it in and have AI make a checklist of facts and documents to gather, flagging confusing questions
text:
Got a new doctor's intake packet or a long application to fill out? Snap a photo of the blank pages first. In ChatGPT, tap the plus sign to add it, then paste:

List every fact and document I'll need to gather before filling in this [type of form], and flag any question that's easy to misread.

Photograph it while it's still blank so no private details go in. Which form is waiting on your table?
